quarterly_data.quarter: Jiujiang Defu Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Jiujiang Defu Technology H1 2026 revenue RMB 9,196,561,806.87, up 73.54% (H1 2025: RMB 5,299,392,576.28); net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 263,458,191.26, up 580.66%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 236,005,112.55, up 1,916.90%; operating cash flow RMB -612,863,178.56. The company attributes the growth to a marked recovery in downstream demand that lifted shipments, a higher share of high-value-added lithium-battery and electronic-circuit foil that raised the average processing fee, and much higher capacity utilisation.

quarterly_data.quarter: Jiujiang Defu Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Jiujiang Defu Technology built capacity was 19.5 ten-thousand tons per year at the end of the period (June 30, 2026). In H1 2026 it acquired 51.17% of Anhui Huiru Technology, an electrolytic copper foil producer, now a subsidiary (H1 revenue RMB 29,227.76 ten-thousand); construction in progress includes an automation upgrade at Anhui Huiru and a slitting plant in Thailand.
quarterly_data.figure: built capacity 19.5 ten-thousand tons per year (end of H1 2026)

quarterly_data.quarter: Jiujiang Defu Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Jiujiang Defu Technology high-end electronic-circuit foil (H1 2026 report): its main electronic-circuit products are now RTF reverse-treated foil and HVLP ultra-low-profile foil. HVLP1-4 are in batch supply, mainly for high-end AI servers, high-end switches and optical modules; HVLP5 has completed sample certification and customer introduction is under way (the R&D section says HVLP4 and carrier copper foil passed customer validation and reached small-batch shipments in the period, and HVLP5 is in certification). RTF-3 and RTF-4 have passed certification at several leading CCL makers and are in batch supply; carrier foil C-IC2 is in mass production in a 1.6T optical-module project; its self-developed embedded-resistor foil has reached industrialisation.
quarterly_data.figure: HVLP1-4 in batch supply; HVLP5 sample certification complete

quarterly_data.quarter: Jiujiang Defu Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Jiujiang Defu Technology started a 5 ten-thousand-ton AI high-end electronic-circuit copper foil project in H1 2026, building lines and facilities for high-end electronic-circuit AI copper foil; when fully ramped it gives 5 ten-thousand tons per year of high-end electronic-circuit foil capacity, core products FPC foil, RTF, HVLP and carrier copper foil. It carried RMB 2,909,723.43 in construction in progress at June 30, 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: 5 ten-thousand tons per year of high-end electronic-circuit foil when fully ramped

quarterly_data.quarter: Jiujiang Defu Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Jiujiang Defu Technology construction in progress at June 30, 2026: the special electronic-circuit copper foil production platform at Amber New Materials (budget RMB 253,460,000.00) was 61.28% complete with RMB 155,313,656.77 in progress; the C-zone electronic-circuit foil phase-1 upgrade (budget RMB 67,500,000.00) was 90.00% complete; the Amber New Materials 5 ten-thousand-ton high-grade copper foil project was 96.40% complete (the raised-fund table dates its intended usable state to 2026 Q1); the Jiangxi Desi Chemical electronic-chemicals project was 82.00% complete.
